articles.title: Meet the Superhero Midwives Saving Lives in Colombia's Jungles
articles.summary: Imagine having a baby with no hospital for miles. In Colombia's remote jungles, traditional midwives like Nohemí Manco are the only help. Manco has delivered about 1,200 babies since she was 14!

articles.title: New York's Election Shocker: Young Socialists Beat Big-Name Democrats
articles.summary: In New York, three candidates backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani—all democratic socialists—won their primaries. The biggest surprise: 32-year-old Darializa Avila Chevalier beat a congressman who's been in office for over 20 years!

articles.title: King Charles Meets a Cricket Team That Can't Play for Its Own Country
articles.summary: King Charles met the Afghan women's cricket team, who are in exile because the Taliban banned women's sports. Player Ekil Latifi, who hasn't seen her family in five years, said they play for all Afghan women who can't.
